title: Urgent patch for stale SAML assertions, RBAC reconciliation race, and KMS rotation fallback in Private deployments
creator: Aisha Patel
description: High-severity production issue observed in several Private deployments: a rare race between SAML assertion cache eviction and RBAC policy reconciliation plus a KMS rotation fallback path causes temporary permissive authorization, missing audit events, and intermittent session validation failures. Multiple customers escalated after observing unexpected access and incomplete audit trails. This ticket tracks the urgent patch, rollout, and short-term mitigations.
impact_summary: Affected Private customers may experience incorrect role grants for short windows (seconds-minutes), lost audit events during ingestion backlog, and login/session decryption errors when KMS rotation is partial. Business impact includes potential unauthorized action exposure and regulator-impacting missing audit logs.
reproduction_steps: 1) Configure Private deployment with SAML SSO and short assertion cache TTL (<=30s).
2) Trigger near-simultaneous SAML login and RBAC policy change (role removal) from Console API.
3) Induce KMS rotation with staggered key propagation across nodes.
4) Observe a window where session validation decryption falls back and RBAC check queries an out-of-date cache while audit_ingest backlog increases.
5) Inspect logs for mismatched assertion ID vs active role bindings and missing audit events in the ingestion queue.
root_cause_analysis: Three independent issues surfaced together: (A) assertion cache eviction race — cache TTL and TTL-triggered recompute race with policy reconciliation path that temporarily references stale bindings; (B) audit ingestion backpressure — audit pipeline retries drop events when queue length spikes during heavy reconciliation; (C) KMS rotation fallback — on decrypt failure some nodes entered a legacy permissive fallback to avoid user-visible errors, inadvertently granting actions during a narrow window.
temporary_mitigations: 1) Force-disable permissive KMS fallback with a platform feature flag (FF_disable_kms_permissive_fallback=true).
2) Increase SAML assertion cache TTL to 5 minutes for Private control plane until fix ships.
3) Scale audit-ingest workers for affected clusters to drain backlog and backfill missing events.
4) Push notice to affected customers describing the incident and controls applied.
5) Apply emergency RBAC reconciliation lock to serialize policy updates for the next 48 hours in impacted customers.
proposed_fix: 1) Remove permissive KMS fallback path; convert decrypt failures to safe_renew_token path that forces user re-auth with deterministic deny during key-sync. 2) Make RBAC reconciliation idempotent and tie assertion cache invalidation to reconciliation completion via a lease; ensure cache misses force a synchronous policy fetch rather than stale reads. 3) Harden audit ingestion to persist to durable queue before ack and add immediate backfill job to replay temporarily dropped events.
rollout_plan: Patch build -> internal canary (dogfood) -> 10% customer canary (non-regulated) -> staged ramp to 100% across all Private deployments. Schedule: build and unit tests (24h), integration & canary (12h), customer canary (12h), ramp (rolling over 48h). Emergency rollback via feature-flag and config revert if regressions observed.
postmortem_notes: Will run full incident postmortem after customer ramp completes; initial focus is on eliminating permissive fallback and ensuring audit backfill finishes.
